verdict.line: You lose if you let him land Q (Obliterate) freely and stack his passive; you win by poking from range and timing E (Disdain) for when W (Indestructible) is down.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has the raw lane advantage here (51.5% Urgot win rate over 1221 games, with lane and solo-kill edge to him), but Urgot's 800-range Q (Corrosive Charge) outranges his 675-range Q (Obliterate), so this is a positioning fight, not a stat-check. Every trade is decided by whether you stay outside his melee range and whether his W (Indestructible) shield is up when you commit E (Disdain).

theirWindow.when: he has landed 2+ hits and is near you
theirWindow.what: He is one hit from Darkness Rise (bonus damage + move speed). Back off or use Q (Corrosive Charge) to poke rather than standing in range for his third hit.

yourWindow.when: his W (Indestructible) is on cooldown (8-12s base)
yourWindow.what: This is your window to commit E (Disdain) and all-in — without W he has no shield to absorb the trade, so land Q (Corrosive Charge) first to slow him into E range.

start.why: 81.5% pick rate and the higher win rate (50.7% over 1250 games) over Doran's Shield here — the lifesteal and damage help you win poke exchanges rather than just survive them.

boots.why: 60.4% pick rate at 51.1% win rate — the magic resist directly answers Mordekaiser's fully magic damage kit and softens his Q and E (Death's Grasp) pulls.

core.why: First item in the top path (55.5% over 182 games) — the armor shred matters since Mordekaiser stacks resistances through his W shield conversions.
Second in every listed core path — the health and shield give you room to survive his all-in once he's committed with E (Death's Grasp).
Highest-pick third item (19.5% at 55.5% win rate) — stacking resistances scales directly against his magic damage over a long lane.

situational.when: he is building burst magic damage and you need the biggest single magic shield (68.1% win rate over 72 games)
the game is going long and you need sustained damage plus survivability (54.4% over 68 games)
you need to dodge his Q and E pulls more than you need tenacity (60.2% win rate over 289 games)

runes.keystoneWhy: 48% win rate at 30.4% pick — rewards landing consecutive autos during your poke windows when he's out of his W shield, amplifying the damage that actually wins trades.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 82.3% of games at 51.3% win rate — Ignite punishes his low-mobility all-ins and denies the healing he gets back from W (Indestructible).

playing.title: Poke before he engages
playing.detail: Your Q (Corrosive Charge) has 800 range against his 675-range Q — land it first in every exchange so you're ahead on the trade before he's even in his own range.

playing.title: Track his passive stacks
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 landed hits. If he's at 2 stacks and closing, disengage or finish the trade with ranged Q rather than letting him complete the buff.

playing.title: Save E for his W cooldown
playing.detail: E (Disdain) only pays off if he can't shield the damage. Watch his W (Indestructible) timer — 8-12s base cooldown — and only commit when it's down.

playing.title: Respect his E pull
playing.detail: Death's Grasp drags you into his melee range. Don't stand in its arc near minions or jungle camps where he can safely initiate it.

playing.title: Deny wave control after level 6
playing.detail: His R (Realm of Death) can isolate you from teleport/flash help for its duration. Don't overextend past the wave once he's level 6 unless you can win the isolated 1v1.

playing.title: Use Purge in extended fights
playing.detail: W (Purge) prioritizes champions you've already hit with Q or E, so always land another ability first — it also triggers Echoing Flames for extra burst in a prolonged trade.

playing.title: Hold R for the execute, not the engage
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death has a 2500 range and executes low-health targets — use it to finish him after a won trade, not to start one, since its 70-100s cooldown is too valuable to waste.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning on timing windows and ability interactions is my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep some distance to deactivate Mordekaiser’s (P). Close in with [E] when his (W) is on cooldown.
